user.title: School Holidays
user.description: Choose the country whose school holidays you want to track.

data_description.country: The list comes live from openholidaysapi.org.

subdivision.title: State / region
subdivision.description: Choose the state or region (school holidays differ by region).

data_description.subdivision: School holiday dates are published per region, e.g. per German federal state.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the school-holidays service. Please try again later.

init.title: School Holidays options
init.description: Adjust how often holiday data is fetched and in which language holiday names are shown. Today/tomorrow switch locally at midnight regardless of the interval.

data_description.update_hours: How often openholidaysapi.org is queried (1-168 hours). Holiday dates rarely change, so 24 hours is plenty.
data_description.language: "Follow Home Assistant language" uses your Home Assistant language. You can also pick or type a two-letter ISO 639-1 code (e.g. DE). If the API has no name in that language, another available name is shown.

stale_data.title: School holiday data for {region} is outdated
stale_data.description:
The school holiday data for **{region}** could not be refreshed for {days} days (last successful update: {last_update}). The sensors keep working with the cached dates, but changes published since then are missing.

Check that Home Assistant can reach `openholidaysapi.org`. This message disappears automatically after the next successful update.
